_meta.name: sh2.* runtime namespace spec
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable contract for the ESTree-JSON cross-repo interface (PLAN.md 1.2). Single source for: the structural gate (estree_gate.pl), the reference runtime (sh2-namespace.mjs), and any further backend runtime (C, sh2runtime). Design doc: backends/c/docs/backend-c-core-needs.md, ask A4.
derived_from: harness/sh2-namespace.mjs (the node reference implementation of the sh2 object)

purity_classes.PureCpu: No I/O, no process spawn, no state beyond its args. Lowerable to native code in any backend (C native expr, JS native expr).
purity_classes.Emulable: Implementable in a backend runtime from the input string(s): string/glob/arith/test/array-store logic; may consult fs for file tests. No process spawn required.
purity_classes.Fs: File I/O via the host OS (POSIX open/read/write/stat/... or node:fs). Not a process spawn.
purity_classes.Spawn: Must fork/exec an external binary, or connect real processes (pipeline). C can use fork/execvp/dup2/pipe directly.
purity_classes.Control: Control-flow signal (break/continue/return) crossing a captured context.
purity_classes.GateFlag: Must never appear in gated output; its presence fails the structural gate.

getVar.semantics: Read shell variable/array/assoc/special-var from the runtime store; env fallback. Special: $? $$ $# $@ $* $0 $1..$9 $-, PWD, HOSTNAME, BASH_VERSION, IFS-keyed joins.

setVar.semantics: Write shell variable (string store). Attribute-aware: intVars (arith coercion), lcVars/ucVars (case), refVars (nameref), roVars.

setLastExit.semantics: Write the $? register (sh2.lastExit). Bash-faithful: last command's exit status.

assign.semantics: Arithmetic assignment x+= / x++ / x-= / x-- via the arith evaluator; setVar semantics.

builtin.semantics: Native builtin dispatch: echo, printf, cd, read, export, set, declare, :, test, shift, unset, ... (~30, harness/builtins.json). Sets $?.

exec.semantics: External command: spawn or builtin. Subject to the exec allowlist (source-named binaries only). Sets $?.

capture.semantics: Command substitution: run the closure, capture stdout, strip trailing newlines (shell semantics).

captureWords.semantics: Command substitution in word-splitting context (unquoted $(...)): capture + IFS-split into words.

fieldSplit.semantics: Bash field-splitting of an unquoted expansion ($var / ${...}) in exec-arg position: IFS-whitespace split with empty words dropped; array result spliced one arg per word (mirrors captureWords).

pipeline.semantics: Pipe stage stdout→next stdin sequentially; exit status = last stage (pipefail flag honored).

redirect.signature: (fn: closure, specs: [{fd, mode, target, interpolate?}]) -> int
redirect.semantics: Run fn with fd redirects: modes r/w/a/r+/heredoc/herestring. fd table semantics (exec 3>file).

subshell.semantics: Copy semantics: env/fd snapshot, run, discard. Not a real process; emulable everywhere.

background.semantics: Run asynchronously; tracked for $! and _finish() join.

test.semantics: Test expression parser/evaluator: unary flags (-f -d -e -s -x -w -r -n -z -L ...), bin ops (= != -eq -ne -lt -le -gt -ge < > =~ -nt -ot -ef), -a/-o, !, parens. File tests consult fs.

caseMatch.semantics: Shell-glob dispatch: pattern list vs value (first match wins). POSIX fnmatch semantics incl. extglob and character classes.

param.signature: (op: str, name: str, a?: str, b?: str, value?: str) -> str
param.semantics: Parameter expansion family: defaults :- :-= :+ :?, case mods ^ ^^ , ,, , length, prefix/suffix removal, substitution, slice, basename/dirname, ${!indirect}.

arith.semantics: Bash arithmetic evaluator over a string expression. Integer only (i64). Bad/empty operand → 0 (bash quirk).

arithEval.semantics: Arithmetic evaluation of a deferred expression (assignment LHS RHS both evaluated).

idiv.semantics: Integer division, truncation toward zero. Zero divisor: throws → whole expansion aborts (bash 'division by 0').

imod.semantics: Integer modulo; sign follows dividend. Zero divisor: throws (bash semantics).

bcSqrt.semantics: Exact arbitrary-precision sqrt (bc -l tier, wasm bc core). C: spawn bc (only genuinely spawn-required family) or link a bignum.

contains.semantics: Native substring test — the grep-test idiom lift (echo X | grep P >/dev/null → String(X).includes(P)).

grepText.semantics: In-memory grep over captured text (pattern families: literal, BRE-free) — native path for $(cmd | grep P).

basename.semantics: POSIX basename with optional suffix strip.

join.semantics: Array→space-joined string (String(v) fallback). The native sh2.join lowering.

listVar.semantics: Array expansion to an argument list (unquoted ${arr[@]} in argv position).

define.semantics: Register a shell function body (closure) in the function table.

callDirect.semantics: Call a native-direct function binding (NATIVE_DIRECT_FNS in the emitter) — the deepest native lowering.

forLoopSync.semantics: Provably-sync for loop twin: no per-iteration promises. BREAK/CONTINUE/RETURN via signal register.

whileLoopSync.semantics: Provably-sync while loop twin (the one whitelisted *Sync: pure CPU by construction).

forLoopBatch.semantics: Checkpointed for loop (sync-ok-loops batch_ok verdict): sync chunks of `batch` iterations with a setImmediate yield between chunks. Mirrors forLoopSync exactly (flatten, GLOB_MAGIC, signals, capture bound) minus the yield cadence. Await-legal contexts only.

whileLoopBatch.semantics: Checkpointed while loop twin of forLoopBatch: mirrors whileLoopSync exactly (lastExit, signals, capture bound) with a setImmediate yield every `batch` iterations.

cstyleForSync.semantics: Provably-sync C-style for ((;;)) twin with native numeric header.

forLoop.semantics: Async for loop (historical; superseded by forLoopSync when provably sync).

whileLoop.semantics: Async while loop (historical; superseded by whileLoopSync).

block.semantics: Run a { ...; } statement group in expression position.

return.semantics: Return signal out of a captured function context.

break.semantics: Break signal out of a captured loop context.

continue.semantics: Continue signal out of a captured loop context.

guard.semantics: NaN guard for numeric tests: non-numeric operand → bash 'integer expression expected' → whole test false.

trimCapture.semantics: Strip trailing newlines from captured stdout (shell command-substitution semantics).

unsupported.semantics: Emitter's unlowered-construct marker. Presence fails the structural gate — never appears in green output.

sh2.fs.semantics: Pure-capture lowerings ($(cat f) → readFile, echo x > f → writeFile) and fs commands. node:fs/promises surface; POSIX equivalents for C. Async-only codegen (gate rejects *Sync fs calls).

sh2.positional.semantics: $# → positional.length, ${@:1} → positional.slice(...), $@ → positional.join(' '). Read-only array of positional params.

sh2.lastExit.semantics: The $? register (read: member access; write: via setLastExit).

Array.isArray.semantics: The sh2.join helper's Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(' ') : String(v). Gate-whitelisted.

Promise.all.semantics: Per-path status aggregation in the rm/mkdir fs-command lift. Gate-whitelisted.
